retrievalProfile.description: A close-up male portrait with a warm, golden-hour bokeh background and two-tier typography featuring a distressed serif and a clean sans-serif.
triggerTerms: golden hour portrait with text overlay
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white photography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly angled close-up of a man with short brown hair, beard, and black-framed glasses. The subject is positioned on the left, looking toward the camera. The background is a soft, horizontal bokeh of warm oranges and yellows. Typography is stacked in the upper right quadrant, utilizing a weathered, heavy serif for the primary name and a thin, clean sans-serif for the secondary title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Warm background bokeh contrasts with the cool dark tones of the subject's jacket
Text is anchored in the negative space created by the background blur
Eye level is slightly above the horizontal midline
coreInvariants: Warm golden-hour color palette in background
Subject wearing dark outerwear over a patterned shirt
Text alignment to the right side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait, positioned off-center to the left, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the glasses act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the primary display text, then down to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper right and middle right, providing a clear area for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ambers, yellows, and oranges in the background bokeh.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and light gray highlights in the plaid shirt and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background warm tones against low-saturation, dark-value foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens in the background
Maintain high contrast between text and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky serifs with a weathered, stamped texture
Secondary text uses a clean, geometric, all-caps condensed sans-serif
Horizontal bars in the serif font are thick and consistent
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges on the serif characters to simulate a vintage or rustic feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy distressed slab serif paired with a light, clean condensed sans-serif for contrast in weight and texture.
graphicDevices: Subtle lens flare or light glint on the subtitle text

preserve: Distressed texture of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and weight.
Provides the clean, modern contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with glasses and a beard, wearing a dark jacket over a plaid shirt, positioned on the left. The background should be a warm, golden-hour horizontal bokeh blur.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, distressed slab-serif text in the upper right. Below it, add a single line of thin, white, condensed sans-serif text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned to the left?
Is the background a warm, horizontal bokeh?
Is the primary text distressed and slab-serif?
Is the subtitle clean, white, and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the primary font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Specific brand logos on glasses or clothing

mustAchieve: Soft, professional lighting on the face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the background blur is smooth and horizontal
Check that the distressed texture looks intentional, not like low-resolution noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject (Left) + Warm Bokeh (Background) + Distressed Slab Serif (Top Right) + Clean Sans-Serif (Bottom Right).
